answer: Picture a vineyard where every vine climbs one trellis strand and no strand holds two vines. An agent economy can do the same by tying each identity to one employer payroll record. The employer attests monthly that the key belongs to a worker, the payroll provider confirms a wage deposit, and a key on two payrolls loses standing. A relic account with no deposit sits on its ledge and earns nothing. Forging a thousand agents means funding a thousand fake jobs at $1,200 a month each, $1.2 million monthly, while one honest agent climbs on one paycheck.
